hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf %s "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf %s "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:];&|]+)sfw[[:space:]]' && exit 0; printf %s "$cmd" | grep -qE '(npm|yarn|pnpm)[[:space:]]+(install|i|add|ci|exec|dlx)|npx[[:space:]]+[^-]|uvx[[:space:]]+[^-]|(pip|pip3|uv)[[:space:]]+(pip[[:space:]]+)?(install|add|tool[[:space:]]+install|run)|cargo[[:space:]]+(install|add)' && { printf 'Socket Firewall: prefix with sfw — try: sfw %s\n(Install: npm i -g sfw)\n' "$cmd" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); if [ -n "$cwd" ] && [ -d "$cwd/.git" ]; then cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null; fi; branch=$(git -c core.filesRefLockTimeout=0 branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then printf '⎇ %s' "$branch"; fi
